scenes.text: What happens to your business the day your best employee quits?
She knows the supplier codes, the tricky customers, and how the schedule really works. None of it is written down.
When she leaves, all of that leaves with her.
Watch the first week without her. An order goes in late. A regular gets the wrong price. The schedule gets double booked.
Nobody did anything wrong. They just didn't know what she knew.
The fix takes an hour a week. Pick one task, and have her write down the steps.
Then test it. Can someone new follow those steps, without asking her?
Which task first? The one only she can do, that you'd miss tomorrow.
Keep the steps where everyone can find them. One shared folder. One page per task.
And she'll thank you for it. She can finally take a real vacation.
Ten weeks later, ten tasks live in the business. Not in one head.
Follow for one business fix every week.
